wayAccess.interpretation: First present unconditional tag; not an intersection of all values.
wayAccess.otherOrMissingValues: Included; destination, delivery, permit and other contextual access are not enforced.

directions.otherValues: Both directions; reversible, alternating and conditional meanings are unsupported. An explicit oneway=no overrides the implicit forward rules.

cost.calculation: Sum original way-shape segment lengths: hypot(deltaLongitude * cos(mean segment latitude), deltaLatitude) * 111195.0802 metres per degree; round each graph edge to centimetres.
cost.objective: Minimum sum of permitted directed edge costs, without travel-time or elevation penalties.
cost.drawing: Simplification and projection do not change cost or connectivity. Zero-cost edges caused by rounding remain valid.

topology.junctions: OSM shared node references, original way endpoints, retained control nodes and restriction via-nodes split selected ways. A visual crossing alone creates no connection.
topology.barriers: Retained as nodes and source evidence; passage is not blocked by barrier tags.
topology.turns: Both via-node and via-way restriction evidence is retained, but turns are not enforced.

coverage.boundary: Selected dated Geofabrik extract; no clipping to the decorative national border and no promise of all routes leaving and re-entering the country.
coverage.ferries: Excluded; sea crossings, islands and Northern Ireland can be disconnected.
coverage.tunnelsBridgesPasses: Included when the road class and basic access filter include the way; no vehicle dimensions, toll, season, weather or closure model.
coverage.components: Retained, including small fragments. Endpoint preparation does not invent connections or guarantee directed reachability.

context: No vehicle specification, departure time or live road status is supplied. The result answers this declared connectivity model.
licence: MIT (profile specification); road data and evidence retain ODbL-1.0
